conflict.summary: R1a reuses global case IDs with different obligations. In particular A03, A05, Q01 and X01 do not mean the same thing in the two authorities, while R1a non-goals exclude the video denominator required by global A03/Q01.
conflict.impact: No R1a live result can honestly satisfy both authorities; declaring the local matrix green under the global IDs would be false-green.
